data.description: Our 7 ft Straight Open Slide is a long, straight red and yellow chute with an open top, reached by a steel ladder. With no turns, the speed builds steadily all the way down, which older children enjoy. The straight line makes it easy to place along a boundary wall, and supervisors can see the child from top to bottom. For a school or park that already has a curved or spiral slide, this gives a simple contrast. The run-out at the bottom is longer than on our 3 ft model, so plan for it. The 3-year warranty covers this slide's galvanised steel and moulded bed. Ask us for a layout drawing.

items.pText: Our 7 ft Straight Open Slide is a long, straight red and yellow chute with an open top, reached by a steel ladder. With no turns, the speed builds steadily all the way down, which older children enjoy. The straight line makes it easy to place along a boundary wall, and supervisors can see the child from top to bottom. For a school or park that already has a curved or spiral slide, this gives a simple contrast. The run-out at the bottom is longer than on our 3 ft model, so plan for it. The 3-year warranty covers this slide's galvanised steel and moulded bed. Ask us for a layout drawing.

Galvanised steel forms the ladder and supports, and the open bed is moulded from weather-proof material. It can be grouted or set self-standing. Because children reach more speed from 7 ft, keep a long, soft landing zone at the foot and check the ladder handrails and bed edges regularly.
